Overview

About Owner.com

Owner is the all-in-one platform that restaurants use to succeed online.

Thousands of restaurant owners use our tools to build their website, drive online orders, create their own branded app, manage their customer relationships, and set up marketing automations.

You can think of it as Shopify meets HubSpot, but specifically for restaurants.

Learn more about the problems we are solving for our customers here.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants–we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

In just over 3 years we\'ve generated tens of millions in revenue, served millions of guests, and processed hundreds of millions of online orders.

More importantly, we’ve helped thousands of restaurant owners save their businesses - and not only survive, but thrive.

Our team

Our team grew from under 100 to nearly 200 talented people in 2024. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2025 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Why we’re looking for you

Owner.com is building the all-in-one platform that helps independent restaurants grow and thrive. Payments are core to our mission - restaurants depend on us to reliably process tens of millions of online orders today. We’re looking for a Payment Operations Lead to design and scale our payments operations, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and reliability as we expand from U.S-based restaurants into international markets.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

The impact you will have

  • Design and implement scalable payment operations processes and controls, ensuring reliable reconciliation, dispute handling, and settlement.
  • Oversee operational risk management (onboarding reviews, transaction monitoring, chargebacks) and partner with Product/Analytics on risk model improvements.
  • Monitor and improve payment performance metrics (approval rates, chargeback ratios, settlement timeliness) to enhance merchant trust and retention.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Analytics to automate operational workflows, reduce manual intervention, and embed ops requirements into product design.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance and risk management as Owner.com evolves its payments infrastructure and prepares for new markets and payments channels.
  • Collaborate closely with Support to improve merchant experiences and streamline escalations.
  • Develop operational playbooks, dashboards, and reporting to provide visibility into performance and risk.
  • Lead remediation of operational incidents and drive continuous improvement.
  • Over time, hire and grow a high-performing Payment Operations team.

Who you’ll work with

  • Report directly to the GM of Payments and partner with leadership to shape Owner.com\’s payments strategy, expanding beyond online ordering into additional payment channels and technologies.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to embed and scale payments across the platform.
  • Align with Finance and Compliance on reconciliation, reporting, and regulatory needs.

What we’re looking for

  • 5–10 years of experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, or payment operations roles.
  • Direct experience with platform payments or marketplace models (Stripe, Adyen, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of payment performance levers (fraud, chargebacks, approval optimization, settlement) and regulatory frameworks (KYC/KYB, AML, PCI, card network rules).
  • Hands-on experience in operational risk management, including onboarding risk, transaction monitoring, and chargeback processes.
  • Proven ability to design scalable processes, implement controls, and own operational metrics.
  • Excellent problem-solving and data analysis skills; comfortable using tools/SQL to dive into payments data.
  • Demonstrated cross-functional collaboration skills with Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance.
  • 2+ years of experience leading or mentoring a team, with readiness and excitement to roll up sleeves as an individual contributor in the short term.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: thrives in ambiguity, adapts quickly, and takes ownership to drive outcomes.

Pay and benefits

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $65,000 - $85,000, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package
  • Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!

Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

Principais atividades

  • Entender objetivos do cliente e traduzir em métricas, KPIs e requisitos de dados.

  • Apoiar experimentações simples (testes A/B, hipóteses e leitura de resultados).

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Python (pandas, numpy; notebooks) e SQL (consultas, otimização básica).
  • Boas práticas de programação: versionamento, documentação, refatoração.
  • Estatística descritiva e noções de inferência (distribuições, intervalo de confiança, teste de hipótese básico).
  • Data visualization e storytelling (princípios de boas práticas e clareza na comunicação).
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Capacidade de traduzir perguntas de negócio em análises e de avaliar riscos/alternativas.
  • Experiência como ponto focal de clientes/consultoria.
  • Otimização de código/consultas e modelagem para analytics (modelagem dimensional, camadas semânticas).
  • Conhecimento de setores atendidos (varejo, shopping, farmacêutico, construção civil) e métricas do domínio.
  • Experiência na criação e sustentação de pipeline de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração/ETL (Airflow) e controle de versão (Git).
  • Experiência com bases não relacionais.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de IA.
  • Remuneração competitiva de acordo com o mercado;
  • Auxílio-Alimentação através do cartão Caju;
  • Plano de Saúde coberto integralmente pela Looq, sem necessidade de coparticipação;
  • Plano Odontológico 100% coberto pela Looq, sem coparticipação;
  • Acesso ao Gympass;
  • Incentivo à leitura;
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade em relação aos projetos;
  • Oportunidade de colaborar com uma equipe incrível.

Estamos em crescimento, e não vão faltar oportunidades para você crescer com a gente!

Saiba mais sobre a Looqbox!

Nascemos em 2013 com um grande propósito: democratizar a cultura de dados dentro das empresas .

Queremos que nossos usuários encontrem informações internas de forma tão simples quanto “dar um Google” — e é por isso que transformar o “dar um Looq” em um hábito do dia a dia é a nossa missão.

Somos uma plataforma de Inteligência Artificial que impulsiona a performance de equipes comerciais e operacionais em grandes empresas. Nosso papel é transformar dados em resultados, aumentando vendas, eficiência e a satisfação dos clientes por meio dos insights gerados pelo Looqbox.

Desde a fundação, nosso time vem crescendo de forma consistente e temos muito orgulho da nossa cultura. Valorizamos a #timetude , a comunicação direta (#chutzpah ), a #curiositude e a #clientude . Esses são os valores que nos guiam e que fazem parte do nosso dia a dia.

Temos muitos desafios pela frente e muito espaço para quem quer crescer e construir junto com a gente.

title: Associate Linux Support Engineer
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Associate Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. This role is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer with eagerness to learn, a passion for Linux and open source technologies to work with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex cloud environments, desktop and server issues, Linux kernel crashes we've never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and customers. You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full technical stack at Canonical, across cloud, desktop and IoT. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. This is a globally remote role.

Location: This is a globally remote role.

The role entails

  • Working from your remote home office to provide technical support for employees.
  • Being available to take ownership of new cases via telephone, email and web
  • Acting as an internal customer advocate keeping them updated in a timely manner
  • Ensuring that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
  • Contributing new knowledge base articles and maintaining existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
  • Drafting and distributing technical notices for internal and external communication.
  • Prioritising your work in order to accomplish the most important and urgent tasks first
  • Keeping on learning as our products and services grow and evolve
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix
  • Maintaining regular communication and information exchange with the rest of the team, locally and remotely
  • Identifying and suggesting any opportunities to provide a better service
  • Participating in a regular weekend working rotation

What we are looking for

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path. Preferable majors: Computer Science, MIS, Electrical Engineering, etc.
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files)
  • Knowledge or basic hands-on experience on 2 or more of:
    • Linux server administration
    • Programming fundamentals in any language (bash, Perl, Ruby, Javascript, C or C++, Go)
    • Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.)
    • Virtualization / Cloud computing concepts (provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.)
  • Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Note: We require and will perform a background check for this role.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience supporting virtualized environments (KVM, Virtual Box, VMWare)
  • Experience with other open-source desktop technologies
  • Active contribution to open-source projects/forum/code

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Microservices Engineer
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a general selection track for teams that focus on back-end REST API microservices engineering in Go and Python. It covers all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are an outstanding engineer with crisp and well-articulated views on APIs, microservice design, engineering processes and DevOps. Our services need to scale to handle millions of Ubuntu clients, and collaboration across thousands of community members. As Ubuntu has been embraced by mainstream enterprise computing through the adoption of cloud and developer-centric tech strategy, the quality of these services has become more important to customers and users. We are growing our teams and aim to level up our insights on scalability, performance, resilience and DevOps practices. Key areas of interest for us are: API design, documentation, and governance; database performance design considerations; multi-region service delivery for resilience and performance; fuzzing and other proactive security analysis techniques; tracing and profiling for distributed systems insights; next-generation DevOps practices.

Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality, well-designed, and robust software that works at scale
  • Design APIs and software architecture for collegial review
  • Write tests that validate software behaviour
  • Build and maintain reliable, fault-tolerant applications and services
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality solutions to resolve them
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Discuss, contribute to, and collaborate across teams at Canonical
  • Work from home with global travel twice annually for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Proficiency in Python and / or Go
  • History of writing modern, maintainable software
  • Experience with relational and non-relational database systems
  • Continuous integration and continuous delivery experience
  • Experience with systems programming or scalable web services
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains
  • Experience with cross-compilation
  • Experience with hyperscale public clouds and / or private clouds
  • Experience with designing, building, and running distributed systems
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy

  • Experience in keyword targeting and audience optimization across multiple platforms

  • Background in data-derived decision-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results

Join to apply for the Forms & Market Research Specialist role at Ruby Labs .

About Us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at:

About The Role

We are expanding our online PDF editing product into a highly localized forms-based solution, starting with tax, legal, and administrative forms like W-9 and scaling globally. We’re looking for a Business Development Analyst who will drive the research, selection, preparation, and launch of high-demand forms across multiple countries. This is a highly operational, research-driven role that requires a mix of analytical thinking, strong ownership, and hands-on execution. You will work closely with Product, Marketing, and Growth teams to identify forms with the highest market demand, prepare them for integration, and help us scale our offering country by country. If you’re resourceful, extremely detail-oriented, and excited about helping build a global product at speed — this is your opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research and identify high-demand forms and templates (tax, legal, administrative, business, etc.), country by country.
  • Analyze search trends, competitor offerings, and market data to prioritize forms by demand potential.
  • Source, download, and prepare forms for use (incl. conversion into fillable PDF format using Acrobat or similar tools).
  • Upload prepared forms into CMS or coordinate with the product team for technical integration.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Growth, and Marketing teams to optimize rollout plans and prioritize backlog.
  • Maintain a clean, well-organized form library with proper metadata, categories, and quality standards.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in business analysis, research, business operations, or product ops.
  • Strong research and analytical skills — ability to collect and synthesize market data quickly.
  • Hands-on experience with PDF tools (e.g., Acrobat) to prepare fillable forms.
  • Excellent organizational and documentation skills — ability to manage large content libraries.
  • Strong collaboration skills — comfortable working with cross-functional teams across Product, Marketing, and Growth.
  • Highly proactive, resourceful, and self-directed — able to independently drive projects forward.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SaaS platforms, document management, or legal/tax content.
  • Experience managing content in CMS or product data platforms.

  • Experience working in a fintech or high-growth startup environment.

We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. What do we need from you?

Based in Washington, DC, Quorum is a fast-growing software company and is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals across the corporations, non-profits, associations, and governmental end-markets. Quorum allows users to manage stakeholder engagement, launch grassroots advocacy campaigns, and track legislative activity at all levels of government, including federal, state and local.

  • You have at least three years of full-time professional experience working as a product operations specialist or product manager, preferably building software as a service (saas) or other B2B solutions.

Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

description:
Responsabilidades

Gestão da Equipe de Programação

  • Coordenar, orientar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas e assistentes de programação de transportes;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho individual e coletivo da equipe, promovendo feedbacks contínuos;
  • Garantir a correta alocação de tarefas, conforme prioridade e perfil técnico da equipe;
  • Identificar necessidades de capacitação e promover treinamentos técnicos e comportamentais.

Planejamento e Programação de Transportes

  • Planejar, junto à equipe, a roteirização diária de cargas e a alocação dos veículos (próprios ou terceiros);
  • Validar os planos de programação, assegurando o cumprimento das janelas de entrega, lead times e níveis de serviço;
  • Monitorar a ocupação da frota e propor melhorias de utilização de veículos e motoristas;
  • Definir prioridades em períodos de pico ou situações críticas (ex: alta demanda, greves, clima);

Gestão de Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)

  • Acompanhar os principais KPIs da área, como OTIF (On Time In Full), custo por km, taxa de ocupação, tempo médio de carregamento, entre outros;
  • Identificar desvios e liderar planos de ação corretivos / preventivos;
  • Apresentar relatórios periódicos à gerência com análise crítica dos resultados e sugestões de melhoria.

Relacionamento com Transportadoras e Fornecedores

  • Negociar melhorias nos contratos de transporte e propor ajustes operacionais junto aos parceiros;
  • Avaliar desempenho das transportadoras e aplicar penalizações quando necessário.

Interface com Outras Áreas

  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Atendimento ao Cliente, Operações, Comercial para garantir alinhamento entre programação e demandas;
  • Participar de reuniões de S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) quando aplicável;
  • Manter fluxo de comunicação eficiente com áreas correlatas sobre prazos, ocorrências e desvios.

Otimização de Processos

  • Mapear e revisar os processos da programação de transportes, buscando ganhos de produtividade e redução de falhas;
  • Implantar e/ou liderar projetos de melhoria contínua (ex: Kaizen, PDCA, Lean Logistics);
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais por meio de ferramentas como Excel, BI ou sistemas integrados

Gestão de Sistemas e Ferramentas

  • Garantir a correta utilização dos sistemas de TMS (Transportation Management System);
  • Validar parametrizações de regras de roteirização e tabelas de frete nos sistemas;
  • Ser o ponto focal entre a área de transportes e a equipe de TI / suporte de sistemas para melhorias e correções.

Gestão de Ocorrências e Contingências

  • Atuar diretamente em situações de crise, como atrasos, avarias, acidentes ou eventos climáticos;
  • Apoiar a equipe na tomada de decisão ágil e eficaz para garantir o menor impacto nas operações;
  • Manter histórico de ocorrências e reportar causas-raiz com ações de prevenção.

Gestão de Custos

  • Acompanhar o orçamento da área de transportes, analisando desvios e oportunidades de redução de custos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais que impactem positivamente os custos (como consolidação de cargas, revisão de malha, menor uso de frete emergencial);
  • Controlar e validar valores pagos a transportadoras, assegurando a conformidade com contratos e operações;

Qualificações

  • Forte domínio de sistemas TMS e ERP;
  • Experiência com KPI logísticos e ferramentas analíticas;
  • Gestão de equipe e orçamento;
  • Conhecimento de contratação de fretes, SLA e negociações.
  • Raciocínio lógico e agilidade na tomada de decisão;
  • Organização e foco em resultado;
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva;
  • Colaboração e cooperação com áreas correlatas;
  • Capacidade de lidar com pressão.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Logística, Engenharia, Administração;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA é desejável.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

Join us on this journey of impact and innovation, connecting people with opportunities that truly improve their everyday lives.

Responsibilities

  • We are seeking a highly skilled and business-driven Specialist Analytics Engineer to join our Finance Data Team. In this pivotal role, you will architect and implement scalable, high-performance analytical solutions by integrating our core SAP data with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. You will be instrumental in translating complex business logic from SAP Datasphere into curated data marts that power strategic decision-making across the organization. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to ensure our data infrastructure drives business impact, data democratization, and innovation.
  • Lead the architecture and development of enterprise-grade Data Products, bridging the gap between SAP's business semantic layer and the Databricks Lakehouse.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines to extract and replicate data from SAP Datasphere into Databricks, utilizing best practices for Change Data Capture (CDC) and data synchronization.
  • Transform and model complex SAP source data (e.g., Finance, Sales) within Databricks to build governed, performant, and business-oriented data marts using PySpark and SQL.
  • Design and oversee the development of strategic dashboards and analytical layers in tools like Tableau or QlikSense, ensuring they are powered by the curated data in Databricks.
  • Act as a data advisor for key departments, helping them leverage SAP data to define KPIs, conduct advanced analyses, and build data-driven decision-making frameworks.
  • Ensure standardization, governance, and version control of implemented analytical solutions using tools like dbt and Git, integrating them seamlessly with existing data pipelines.
  • Champion initiatives for analytical automation and data democratization, promoting the use of self-service tools and internal training on our SAP and Databricks stack.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering, Product, and Technology teams to build solutions that connect data to digital products, processes, and business strategies.
  • Mentor other analytics professionals, fostering technical development, methodological consistency, and data storytelling best practices.
  • Represent the Analytics Engineering discipline in data governance, data quality, and data architecture committees, contributing to enterprise-level guidelines for our integrated data platform.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience with SQL and PySpark for transforming, modeling, and processing large-scale, complex datasets, particularly from SAP systems.
  • Understanding of SAP data structures and core business processes (e.g., Finance (FI/CO))
  • Proven ability to design and build analytical views and reusable data assets, aligned with business logic and performance standards.
  • Proficiency in visualization tools preferably Tableau or equivalent platforms (e.g., Qlik Sense, Power BI, Looker).
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, including the development of business-oriented data marts and analytical models.
  • Familiarity with dbt, Git, and collaborative documentation tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Markdown-based wikis).
  • Ability to translate business requirements into governed, maintainable, and scalable analytical solutions.
  • Design cross-domain analytical solutions that are interoperable and scalable beyond individual products or squads.

Nice to Have

  • Proven hands-on experience with SAP Datasphere, including connecting to SAP source systems (e.g., S/4HANA), data modeling in the Business Builder, and creating consumption views for external access.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

description:
Overview

Job description

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

description:
About Bonsai

Bonsai is an all-in-one platform helping agencies, consultancies, and professional service firms run and scale their operations. From lean 5-person studios to 100-person teams, thousands of businesses around the world rely on Bonsai to streamline their workflows and manage everything from proposals and contracts to tasks, time tracking, invoicing, and finances.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Data Onboarding Specialist to join our team and play a key role in helping new customers set up and migrate their data into Bonsai.   • Support ongoing operational data needs as Bonsai scales

What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced experience with Excel and Google Sheets
  • Strong attention to detail —accuracy and quality of data is very important for this role
  • Excellent English communication skills , both written and verbal
  • Ability to work independently, stay highly organized, and juggle multiple onboarding projects

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in SaaS onboarding or operations
  • Background at a fast-growing tech company or fintech
  • Remote-first role
  • Work closely with a global team in a fast-growing SaaS company
  • All-expenses-paid team retreats — our last retreat was in Lisbon
  • A chance to make a real impact on a product that helps small businesses succeed
